D.t: Glenn Ivey leads by 82.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 241,782 votes; a one point swing is about 1,462 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +79.5 and D +85.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
